text.tspan: Show HUD
- Everything on or off.
Lock
- Stops all mouse editing, so a stray CTRL-click cannot move anything.
Auto-hide out of combat
- Hides the whole HUD until combat starts. The open menu always shows
Auto-hide combo at 0
- Hides the combo points while you have none and are out of combat.
Snap items to grid / Grid size
- Drops land on the grid; Grid size (8 to 64) sets the spacing.
Join energy, regen and swing into one bar
- Switch on from the HUD tab. The regen overlay sits

svg.text: on the energy bar and the swing strip runs under it; the three move and scale together. Each
keeps its own colours and options.

text.tspan: Stick items together
- A drop right next to another item abuts its edge. Needs Snap on.

svg.text: Each element: Mana bar, Mana regen, Swing timer, Combo points, Recent actions

text.tspan: Show
- The switch on the right of the element's heading.
Width / Height
- The shape of the bar or of one pip or icon.
Opacity
Scale
- Size of the whole item, 0.5 to 3. The same value as CTRL + wheel on the item. Hold CTRL

svg.text: and roll the wheel over this slider to step it by 0.05.

text.tspan: Show the value as text
- The number on the bar, on or off.
Show mana / sec
- The rate printed on the regen bar.
Full at
- The rate per second at which the regen bar is completely full (5 to 60).
Use skin colour, Bar red / green / blue
- Take the bar colour from the skin, or mix your own.
Background opacity
- How solid the empty part of the bar is.
Spark, Spark size
- The bright marker at the moving edge, and its size (8 to 40).
Text and its mode
- Off, or one of: elapsed / total, remaining, percent.
Ticks, Tick count
- Marks across the bar (1 to 10).
Ready flash
- The bar glows for the last 0.2 seconds of a swing.
Source
- Where the swing length comes from: the swing event, or polling your attack speed.
Reset on target change
- A new target restarts the bar.
Manual speed override, Manual speed
- Force a swing length (0.5 to 4 s), for testing.

svg.text: Text rows inside each bar's block (2 build)

text.tspan: Font, Font size
- This text's own typeface and size (6 to 40).
Anchor, Offset X / Y
- Which point of the bar the text hangs from (centre, a side or a corner)
Format, Decimals
- What the number says: current / max, current, percent or deficit for the bar;

svg.text: rate and decimals for regen and swing.
